topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the main learning outcomes and connecting the content to prior practical work.

topics.label: Viral transformation and the discovery of cellular oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how investigating transforming viruses and in vitro cell assays established that cancer originates from altered cellular genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms and classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions and regulatory mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes in cell cycle control and phenotypic expression.

topics.label: Mechanisms of genetic instability and multi-step progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how failures in DNA repair pathways and mitotic segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability to drive tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predispositions and tumor maintenance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how germline mutations predispose individuals to cancer and evaluate whether genomic instability remains essential for tumor maintenance.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by providing recommended reading and previewing the next session.
